ETmain-compatible Omni-bot bridge ABI, copied from
etlegacy/vendor/omni-bot/source/Omnibot/Common and /ET on 2026-10-08.
These files are byte-identical to the matching vendored runtime sources in
../omni-bot/source/Omnibot. Do not mix headers from the incompatible upstream tree.

provenance. No generated binaries are included.

Reviewed project update (2026-10-26): the matching core/bridge loaders retain
existing desktop names and add explicit ARMv7 and Android ABI suffixes. Both
loader copies were changed together; no upstream revision is invented.
